name: centroid_eq_centroid_image_of_inj_on
statement: ι → P} (hi : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, p i = p j → i = j) {ps : Set P} [Fintype ps] (hps : ps = p '' ↑s) : s.centroid k p = (univ : Finset ps).centroid k fun x => (x : P)

name: centroid_vsub_const
statement: ι → P} {p₀ : P} (hs : s.Nonempty) : Finset.centroid k s p -ᵥ p₀ = Finset.centroid k s (fun i => p i -ᵥ p₀)
